purpose: An input or textarea with an optional proposed suffix that the user explicitly accepts or dismisses.
behaviorProvider: Shared TextInput/Textarea, Field integration and explicit completion acceptance.

component: Show a completion only when enabled and editable, the caret/selection is at the end, the full suggestion starts with current text and is longer, it was not dismissed, and it fits maxLength.

Accept only through the explicit action or unmodified forward Tab while a completion is available. Skip key interception when the caller prevented default or composition is active. Ordinary Tab navigation is preserved when no completion is eligible.
host: Supply the full proposed value, including the current prefix, and accept controlled text updates.
Own model calls, suggestion freshness, validation, data handling and persistence. Make suggestion content safe and relevant.

requirements.statement: Show a completion only when enabled and editable, the caret/selection is at the end, the full suggestion starts with current text and is longer, it was not dismissed, and it fits maxLength.

Accept only through the explicit action or unmodified forward Tab while a completion is available. Skip key interception when the caller prevented default or composition is active. Ordinary Tab navigation is preserved when no completion is eligible.

Acceptance updates the uncontrolled value or emits onValueChange for a controlled value, then calls onAccept and restores input focus/caret to the suggestion end. Escape dismisses the current suggestion and calls onDismiss without changing text.
Keep the ghost rendering hidden from assistive technology and scroll-aligned. Associate a polite text hint describing the suggestion and acceptance keys with the native control.
Forward the public ref to the actual input/textarea and merge Field naming, description, disabled, required and invalid metadata.
Supply the full proposed value, including the current prefix, and accept controlled text updates.
Own model calls, suggestion freshness, validation, data handling and persistence. Make suggestion content safe and relevant.

Use ai group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: No model request, debounce, approval policy or server persistence is implemented.
Dismissal remembers a suggestion string; supplying that same string again does not automatically clear dismissal.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
